Class manager_inventory_history

java.lang.Object
controller.manager_inventory_history
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class manager_inventory_history extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Displays history of inventory

This code populates the fxml history page with the line chart with the different inventory entities in the postgres table.
